subject: media-studies
intro: Media studies leads into the industries the course analyses — producing and directing, editing, designing the images audiences see, and shaping what audiences read about brands.

roles.title: Producers and Directors
roles.what: Produce or direct stage, television, video or film productions, owning the creative decisions — how the script is interpreted, who is cast, and how sets, sound and effects come together.
roles.where: The television in-depth study and the film marketing case study are the production world the course examines, and the media language framework — why each creative choice communicates — is the analytical base of a director's craft.

roles.title: Film and Video Editors
roles.what: Edit moving images on video or other media, organise shots into a final production and synchronise soundtracks with images, working to a producer's or director's brief.
roles.where: The music video in-depth study is an editing lesson in itself — rhythm, cuts and meaning — and the creating media products component has you assembling footage where every edit decision changes what the audience reads.

roles.title: Public Relations Specialists
roles.what: Promote or create an intended public image for individuals, groups or organisations, writing and selecting material for release across media, increasingly through social platforms.
roles.where: The online, social and participatory media in-depth study plus the audiences framework teach how publics are built and reached, and the industries unit on ownership and funding shows how publicity and news interact.

roles.title: Graphic Designers
roles.what: Design graphics to meet commercial or promotional needs — packaging, displays, logos and campaign artwork — across print and digital mediums for clients and brands.
roles.where: Magazine front covers, film posters and print advertisements are the set texts of the exploring media language unit, and the magazine and film marketing production components have you designing them yourself.

roles.title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
roles.what: Research conditions in local, national or online markets, gathering data on competitors, prices and sales to plan marketing and advertising campaigns and analyse web metrics.
roles.where: The audiences strand of the theoretical framework — how audiences are categorised, counted and targeted — and the ownership, funding and regulation study are exactly the commercial logic a market researcher applies.
